Based on the search results, here's information about these three renowned restaurants in Marrakech's Medina:

## Nomad

Nomad has become one of Marrakech's most sought-after restaurants in the heart of the medina. Housed in a former carpet shop transformed into a contemporary dining space, it combines clean-lined design with local materials. The menu combines Moroccan and European influences with sharing dishes served in surroundings where traditional architecture meets contemporary design. Nomad has a rating of 4.3 stars.

## Le Jardin

Hidden away down a secluded Medina alleyway, Le Jardin brings a touch of French elegance and refinement to the bustle of the Marrakech old town and is an oasis of peace within the chaotic world of the Medina. Located in a 17th-century mansion, Le Jardin is built around a large central courtyard and features a beautiful combination of traditional Moroccan design and retro 1960s decor. Address: 32 Souk Jeld Sidi Abdelaziz, Medina, Marrakech. Le Jardin has a rating of 4.3 stars.

## Dar Yacout

Dar Yacout is one of the city's most celebrated ambassadors of Moroccan gastronomy, founded by Mohamed Zkhiri and housed in a historic riad with magnificent surroundings featuring private salons, intricate zellige tilework and finely carved cedar wood. Dar Yacout has a rating of 4.2 stars and offers a fixed Moroccan tasting menu in a palace riad.
